name: uninterpretable-keyed-lww-key-only
description: WRIT-345 item 8 (spec/fold.md §7.1): a non-string value at a declared keyed-lww key component makes the whole operation uninterpretable, even though it never writes the keyed field itself. Expected: op-2 is rejected per-operation, so its `title` write is discarded too and `title` stays at op-1's value.
